name: Mixed-use (combined components)
summary: Quick-mode fallback for vertical mixed-use (residential over ground-floor retail with podium/structured parking). There is no published 'mixed-use' $/SF benchmark; the blended default is derived from component costs (RLB Q3 2026 multifamily and retail ranges, the podium-multifamily file in this database) weighted ~85% residential / 15% retail, plus a small mixed-occupancy premium. For detailed budgets the engine should build mixed-use from its component types instead.

typicalSize.method: Typical 4-7 story podium mixed-use block of ~120-250 units at ~1,050 SF/unit plus 10-25k SF retail -> ~150k SF GFA (judgment, consistent with podium-multifamily sizing).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per acre of site = FAR x 43,560: FAR 2 (87k), 3 (130k), 5 (218k) for podium/wrap mixed-use (judgment).

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per SF of GFA: ~1.0 space per residential unit (~1,050 SF) plus 2-4 per 1,000 SF retail blended ~1.0 per 1,000 SF; 0.6-1.5 per 1,000 SF by market/parking reform (judgment).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Blend per SF of GFA (parking area excluded from SF, its cost included): 0.85 x residential podium mid $290 (podium-multifamily.json) + 0.15 x ground-floor retail shell $249 (median of RLB Q3 2026 18-city 'Retail - Strip' midpoints, e2) = $284; x 1.04 mixed-occupancy premium (fire separation/transfer level, split MEP, acoustic separation, separate egress/loading — judgment) = $295. Low: 0.85 x $235 (podium low) + 0.15 x $178 (RLB Phoenix strip midpoint) = $226. High: tower mixed-use, 0.85 x $410 (highrise-multifamily mid) + 0.15 x $300 x 1.05 = ~$413, rounded up to $450 for gateway cities. RLB 18-city multifamily median midpoint is $347.5/SF (e1), so the mid sits at the lower-cost-market end of RLB, consistent with the sibling residential files.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P for residential over cold/warm-shell retail with podium parking (~1 space/unit) and on-site work. Excludes retail and residential FF&E, tenant improvements (line item), land, soft costs, off-sites, impact/tap fees. SF = gross building area excluding parking-deck area.

systemSplit.method: Weighted blend 0.85 x podium-multifamily.json systemSplit + 0.15 x retail-strip.json systemSplit (both derived in those files), renormalized to 1.000 (01 trimmed by 0.001 for rounding).

lineItems.name: Retail tenant improvement allowance (landlord-funded TI)

cost.method: Landlord TI allowances typically fund part of the $75-400/SF tenant fit-out (interior-finish-out e4); $40-150/SF of retail area is judgment. Qty = retail share of GFA (0.15 SF retail per SF GFA).

lineItems.notes: Often carried as a soft/leasing cost; leave off if TI is tenant-funded.

lineItems.name: Additional above-grade structured parking (beyond podium)

cost.method: Per-space garage cost from parking-garage.json (WGI 2026 median $33,300; Houston $27,806; RLB/UCLA above-ground average $52,000).

lineItems.notes: Enter spaces above the ~1 per unit already in the podium baseline.

cost.method: UCLA ITS / RLB 2025 underground $73,000 vs above-ground $52,000 per space -> ~$21,000 premium (parking-garage e4).

lineItems.name: Public plaza / streetscape enhancements inside the property line

cost.method: Specialty paving, planters, seating, lighting — estimating judgment per SF of plaza.

pctOfHard.method: Same basis as podium-multifamily (RAND market-rate soft/hard 0.19-0.33, mid 0.25) — mixed-use adds retail leasing/legal and condo/REA documents, so the range is shifted up slightly at the low end (judgment).

softCosts.notes: Excludes retail leasing commissions and TI (see line item).

design.method: Multi-occupancy coordination adds design risk over single-use podium (judgment).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Hard low $225 x 1.20 soft = $270 (min rounded to $250); hard high $450 x 1.32 soft x 1.08 contingency = ~$640 -> $650.

evidence.region: 18 U.S. cities (RLB; median of city midpoints)

source.title: RLB Construction Cost Report North America Q3 2026 (PDF), Indicative Construction Costs — Residential: Multi-Family

evidence.quote: MULTI-FAMILY (USD/SF GFA): Austin 190-285; Dallas 195-285; Phoenix 205-305; Chicago 235-505; New York 260-510; San Francisco 420-700
evidence.scopeNotes: Hard construction cost per SF of gross floor area, all multifamily types. Median of the 18 US city midpoints = $347.5 (our arithmetic).

evidence.region: 18 U.S. cities (RLB; median of city midpoints)

source.title: RLB Construction Cost Report North America Q3 2026 (PDF), Indicative Construction Costs — Retail: Strip

evidence.quote: RETAIL STRIP (USD/SF GFA): Austin 200-265; Dallas 200-270; Phoenix 135-220; Chicago 170-280; New York 395-795; San Francisco 360-720
evidence.scopeNotes: Stand-alone strip retail; used as a proxy for ground-floor retail shell in a podium. Median of 18 US city midpoints = $248.75 (our arithmetic).

openQuestions: Find a public cost breakdown (e.g., city-assisted mixed-use project pro forma or LIHTC mixed-use application) to test the 4% mixed-occupancy premium.
Engine design: should quick-mode mixed-use defer to a weighted blend of the user's chosen components rather than this single fallback?
